consumer: mission::is_complete (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM) asking 'does the player have >=20 scrap within crafting reach so the salvage objective counts as complete?'
scope: items reachable nearby for crafting (carried items PLUS adjacent/within-reach inventory), via crafting_inventory() -- not on-person carried items only
decisive_source: src/mission.cpp::mission::is_complete -- for MGOAL_FIND_ITEM it builds u.crafting_inventory() and returns whether has_amount(item_id, item_count) (with a charges fallback) reaches the required count, i.e. it EVALUATES a computed yes/no completion predicate
divergence: avatar carries only 5 scrap but stands adjacent to a tile/pile holding 15+ more scrap within crafting reach: the true crafting_inventory() predicate returns complete (>=20) while an on-person/carried-only has_amount answers incomplete, exposing wrong scope
